meta.name: box-automation
meta.description: Automate Box cloud storage operations including file upload/download, search, folder management, sharing, collaborations, and metadata queries via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理云存储文件与协作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要批量操作Box云盘文件或管理共享权限
copy.tagline_en: Automate cloud storage file management and collaboration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to batch manage Box files or sharing permissions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你操作 Box 云盘：上传下载文件、搜索内容、管理文件夹、分享文件、管理协作权限，还能处理电子签名请求。
howto.when: 当你要求操作 Box 云盘，比如“上传文件到 Box”、“搜索 Box 里的文档”、“分享文件给同事”时触发。

say.text: 帮我上传桌面上的 report.pdf 到 Box 根文件夹。
say.note: Claude 会调用上传工具，将文件上传到 Box 根目录。

say.text: 搜索 Box 里标题包含“预算”的 Excel 文件。
say.note: Claude 会使用搜索工具查找匹配的文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you operate Box cloud storage: upload/download files, search content, manage folders, share files, manage collaborations, and handle sign requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to perform Box operations, such as 'upload a file to Box', 'search for documents in Box', or 'share a file with a colleague'.

say_en.text: Upload the report.pdf on my desktop to the Box root folder.
say_en.note: Claude will call the upload tool to upload the file to Box root.

say_en.text: Search Box for Excel files with 'budget' in the title.
say_en.note: Claude will use the search tool to find matching files.

say_en.text: Share the file with ID 123456 in Box with user@example.com as editor.
say_en.note: Claude will create a collaboration invitation.
